candidates.change_summary: Replace the balance credit 'balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value;' with 'balances[msg.sender]+= 1;', so the deposited amount recorded is always 1 wei regardless of msg.value.
Replace 'balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value;' with 'balances[address(this)]+= msg.value;', crediting the contract's own entry in the mapping instead of the depositor's.
Delete the statement 'balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value;' so deposits are logged but never credited to the sender's balance.
Replace 'balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value;' with 'balances[msg.sender]+= MinSum;', crediting MinSum instead of the actual deposited value.
Remove the require(!intitalized) guard so SetMinSum can also modify MinSum after the contract has been initialized.
Delete the assignment MinSum = _val so calls to SetMinSum no longer change MinSum.
Change the assignment to always store zero instead of the argument, so MinSum() always reads 0 after SetMinSum.
Change the assignment to store _val + 1 so MinSum() reads one more than the argument passed to SetMinSum.
Remove the assignment MinSum = _val so the setter no longer updates MinSum.
Replace the assignment MinSum = _val with MinSum = 0 so SetMinSum always becomes zero after a successful call.
Invert the guard to require(intitalized) so the function reverts before initialization and can only run after initialization.
Remove the assignment to Log so SetLogFile never updates the Log address.
Assign Log to a LogFile wrapping msg.sender instead of _log.
Changed `balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value;` to `balances[msg.sender] = msg.value;`, so the balance is overwritten instead of incremented.
Changed `balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value;` to `balances[msg.sender]-= msg.value;`, so the deposit subtracts instead of adds.
Changed the require guard from `>=` to `>` so that deposits of zero value revert.
Deleted the `Log.AddMessage(msg.sender,msg.value,"Put");` call so deposits are no longer recorded in the log history.
